spanish: Y la medida de los ladrillos que ellos hacían ayer anteayer pondrán sobre ellos; no disminuirán de nosotros, porque flojos *son* ellos; por eso ellos claman, diciendo: Andemos, sacrifiquemos a nuestro Dios.
grammarChanges: de ella → de nosotros: packet morph on h02005008013 (מִמֶּנּוּ) is preposition + 1cp suffix (from us); the draft's 3fs pronoun agreeing with medida did not match the suffix person.
son → *son*: marked the supplied copula in italics, since the participle + pronoun clause (h02005008015/h02005008016) only licenses a copula when marked.
readerNote: Changed 'de ella' to 'de nosotros' to match the 1cp suffix on the preposition, and marked the supplied copula as *son*.
